name: Southwest Rapid Rewards Performance Business Credit Card

localized_names.en: Southwest Rapid Rewards Performance Business Credit Card

fx_fee.notes: No foreign transaction fees. 'You will pay no foreign transaction fees when you use your card for purchases made outside the United States.'

categories.label: Rapid Rewards hotel and rental car partners
Gas stations, dining at restaurants, and hotels booked directly
Local transit and commuting, including rideshare
Social media and search engine advertising; internet, cable, and phone services

rewards.redemption_notes: Points automatically transferred to Southwest Airlines. 9,000 bonus points each account anniversary year. 2,500 TQPs for every $5,000 spent annually. 10,000 Companion Pass qualifying points boost each year.

signup_bonus.description: Earn 80,000 points after you spend $5,000 on purchases in the first 3 months from account opening.

benefits.title: Complimentary Preferred seat at booking
benefits.description: Select a Preferred seat at booking, at no additional charge, when available. For flights operating with assigned seating in 2026 and beyond.

benefits.title: First checked bag free
benefits.description: Cardmembers and up to 8 additional passengers in the same reservation can check their first bag at no additional cost. Savings up to $360 roundtrip for a group of 4.

benefits.title: Extra Legroom seat upgrade
benefits.description: Unlimited upgrades to an Extra Legroom seat within 48 hours prior to departure, at no additional charge, when available.

benefits.title: Group 5 Boarding benefit
benefits.description: Cardmembers and up to 8 passengers in the same reservation will board with Group 5.

benefits.title: 25% back on inflight purchases
benefits.description: 25% back on Southwest Airlines inflight purchases in the form of a statement credit.

benefits.title: 9,000 anniversary points each year
benefits.description: Receive 9,000 bonus points each year after your Cardmember anniversary.

benefits.title: 2,500 Tier Qualifying Points per $5,000 spent
benefits.description: Earn 2,500 tier qualifying points (TQPs) toward A-List status for every $5,000 spent in purchases annually.

benefits.title: 10,000 Companion Pass qualifying points boost
benefits.description: 10,000 Companion Pass qualifying points boost each year.

benefits.title: Employee cards at no additional cost
benefits.description: Employee cards at no additional cost and earn points on employee spending.

benefits.title: Global Entry/TSA PreCheck/NEXUS fee credit up to $120
benefits.description: Receive one statement credit of up to $120 every four years as reimbursement for the application fee for Global Entry, TSA PreCheck or NEXUS.

benefits.title: No foreign transaction fees
benefits.description: No foreign transaction fees on purchases made outside the United States.

benefits.title: No blackout dates and unlimited reward seats
benefits.description: No blackout dates and unlimited reward seats apply to flights booked with points.

benefits.title: Lost Luggage Reimbursement
benefits.description: Reimbursement up to $3,000 per covered traveler for lost, damaged or stolen baggage.

benefits.title: Baggage Delay Insurance
benefits.description: Reimburses up to $100 a day for up to 3 days for essential purchases when baggage is delayed over 6 hours.

benefits.title: Extended Warranty Protection
benefits.description: Extends manufacturer's U.S. warranty by an additional year, on eligible warranties of three years or less, up to four years from date of purchase.

benefits.title: Purchase Protection
benefits.description: Covers eligible new purchases for 120 days against damage or theft up to $10,000 per item.

travel_perks.free_checked_bags: First checked bag free for cardmember and up to 8 passengers on same reservation
other: Extra Legroom seat upgrades within 48 hours of departure

notes: Verified from official Chase product page. Network corrected from mastercard to visa (all Chase Southwest cards are Visa Signature). Earn structure verified from official page: 4X Southwest, 3X Rapid Rewards hotel/car partners, 2X gas/dining/hotels-direct, 2X local transit & rideshare, 2X advertising/internet/cable/phone, 1X all else (some 2X/3X categories were promotional through 12/31/2025 per the page). Southwest airline perks re-labeled source 'co-brand'; Visa travel/purchase protections re-labeled 'network'.
